provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Marrowynd is centered at 61.785677, -112.285013 under Representative Democracy, with 43,221,000 people across 11 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Marrowynd occupies 6,188,436.06 sq mi / 16,027,975.82 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 3.142334% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Partial forest, Beach and grass with water and Farming define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement, Partial forest and Farming. Population density is 2.697 people/sq km / 6.984 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Fey and Trickster Folk, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Harengon, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie, Satyr, Changeling, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Nefaric Veil, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Nefarokir, Eirzunet, Sigrananna, Thalunesh, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 19 recorded four-province geography group links, including 17 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Hannik Vox
npcs.description:
Hannik Vox is a theatrical, hedonistic, sharp-smiling Gwynis mayor who looks like trouble, talks like a revolutionary, and still somehow means it when they promise the unwanted will have a place to sleep. As a dream-born Gwynis, they/he carries Raeshkul and Eirzunet’s influence through memory, illusion, psychic insight, and shadowed dreamcraft, using charm and eerie perception to read a room before deciding whether it needs mercy, blackmail, or a knife.
Years ago, Hannik fled polished civic cruelty, fell into grief and black-market ichor, and deliberately took a dangerous pure dose that changed their body, slowed their aging, and made them impossible to fully separate from the vice-soaked underworld they now protects. From the Vice District Civic Hall, Hannik governs Seawynd Hollow with a loose hand and a hard line: revelry, sex work, ichor use, smuggling, and ugly survival are tolerated, but predators who threaten the district’s outcasts become public examples very quickly.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Seawynd Hollow is a City in Marrowynd, under Representative Democracy, with high danger, Partial forest, Deep forest, Marshes and swamps terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Gwynis reads through the Gwynis entry of the race compendium, within Psionic, Astral, and Alien Minds, marked by Raeshkul. Dream-Born Ethereals of Illusion, Memory, and Psychic Insight. Table cues: ancestral instincts, homeland pressure, and local reputation; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Neutral - Honorable.
rumors: Hannik Vox knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Sigranday.
Hannik Vox has a contact in Pokbith who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Hannik Vox asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Hannik Vox's public story is incomplete.
